hits.name: Ahmed Hassan
hits.about_user: Ahmed Hassan, originally from Australia, brings a wealth of property consulting and operations management expertise to Dubai’s dynamic real estate market. During his tenure at Ray White, Ahmed earned the prestigious title of "Best Leasing Consultant," a testament to his ability to exceed client expectations and deliver exceptional results. Fluent in English, Urdu, Hindi, and Punjabi, Ahmed connects effortlessly with a diverse range of clients, offering a seamless, client-focused experience tailored to individual needs. His meticulous attention to detail and exceptional communication skills ensure a professional and rewarding property journey for all. Beyond real estate, Ahmed’s passion for fitness and wellness is evident in his disciplined daily routines, including kickboxing and workouts. His energy and commitment make him an invaluable member of the haus & haus team and a trusted guide in Dubai’s fast-paced market.

hits.name: Ahmed Ben Saad
hits.about_user: Ahmed Ben Saad is a luxury Property Advisor at fäm Properties, specializing in Dubai’s secondary market, with particular expertise in City Walk and selected off-plan opportunities. He supports both investors and end users with transparent advice, strong market knowledge, and tailored property solutions designed around their lifestyle needs or investment goals. In addition to City Walk, he also assists clients looking to buy premium properties across other key areas of Dubai.
